limitations.statement: PFAS-rich AFFF is a complex matrix with multiple co-contaminants, and the abstract indicates that multi-contaminant interactions and transformations are only partially characterized.

matrix.value: aqueous film-forming foam (AFFF) containing PFAS mixtures

pfas_scope.value: PFAS mixtures in AFFF (individual compounds not specified)

residuals_byproducts.statement: Transformation behavior of co-contaminants, including chloride, was evaluated alongside PFAS degradation in AFFF during ultrasound treatment.

study_scale.value: laboratory-scale sonolysis experiment (exact scale not specified in abstract)
